The smallest piece of value the team builds, described from the user's side. Stories hang off a Deliverable, may be grouped in an epic, and must meet the definition of ready before a sprint and the definition of done after.

- **Definition:** [Glossary: User story, INVEST](/system/glossary)
- **How it works:** [11 Deliverables and user stories](/system/deliverables-and-user-stories)
- **Owner:** product owner writes; development team estimates
- **Links to:** Parent: [Deliverable](/templates/deliverable). Optional: [Epic](/templates/epic)

## Template

```
Title: short, clear, memorable
Why: context; the goal this serves
Story: As a [specific user], I need to [action], so that I can [benefit]
Requirements: anything already known
Estimate: optional; story points if the team uses them
Links: parent Deliverable, epic (if any), story map, designs, decisions
Acceptance criteria:
  Scenario 1: [title]
    Given [context]  When [event]  Then [outcome]
Notes
```

**Definition of ready**

- [ ] Fits the story format and links to its Deliverable
- [ ] Meets INVEST, including small enough for one sprint
- [ ] Acceptance criteria written as scenarios
- [ ] Refined at least once; more than one person agrees it's ready
- [ ] Design done, or not needed
- [ ] Accessibility needs named (WCAG 2.1 AA, language access)
- [ ] Privacy: collects new data, or uses or shares existing data in a new way? If yes, privacy review done
- [ ] Security and architecture decisions made; dependencies on other teams cleared
- [ ] Rollout decided (beta flag or not); training or help content flagged

**Definition of done**

- [ ] Acceptance criteria met
- [ ] Code reviewed; unit, integration and functional tests pass
- [ ] Accessibility checked with keyboard and screen reader
- [ ] Security and other non-functional requirements met
- [ ] Deployed to production, or deployable behind a flag
- [ ] Release note, help content and internal docs updated where needed
- [ ] Product owner accepts the story

Review both lists at retrospectives.

## DMV example

```
Title: Submit a birth certificate photo
Why: Goal 2. Most repeat trips come from document problems.
Story: As a first-time applicant, I need to submit a photo of my birth certificate
       before my visit, so that I can know it will be accepted without making a trip.
Requirements: JPG, PNG or PDF; 10 MB limit; privacy review done (new data)
Estimate: 5 (after the split; the first version was 13)
Links: Deliverable "Pre-check for birth certificates and proof of address";
       epic "Birth certificate check";
       License Ready Check story map; intake queue spike
Acceptance criteria:
  Scenario 1: Valid upload
    Given I started a License Ready Check  When I upload a JPG, PNG or PDF under 10 MB
    Then I see "Received. Staff will review it within 2 business days."
  Scenario 2: Invalid file
    Given I started a check  When I upload another file type or a file over 10 MB
    Then I see what to change, and nothing goes to staff
Notes: first version covered every document type and was estimated at 13, so the
       team split it by document type
```
